sn_aia_version.instructions: 1. Read JR by sys_id -> number, role_title, headcount, required_skills, stage. JR missing or headcount missing/0 -> stop, create nothing, report reason. 2. Get all non-cancelled Interviews for the JR (sys_id, application, candidate, panelist, interview_status, synthesis_status). None -> stop and report. 3. Get all SUBMITTED Interview Feedback for the JR. None -> stop and report. 4. Match feedback to interviews. Interview with no SUBMITTED feedback -> Feedback Missing, skip. Two rows -> use latest submitted_at. 5. Detect score scale (5, 10 or 100) and convert every score to a percentage. 6. Classify each candidate: Qualified / Reject / Hold using the thresholds. 7. Rank all candidates with feedback. Top qualified up to headcount = SELECT, other qualified = HOLD. Fewer qualified than headcount -> places stay unfilled. 8. Look up existing Hiring Decisions for the JR. 9. For each ranked interview: a. human_decision set -> Already Decided, no write. b. Record exists, no human decision -> Update Hiring Decision Record. c. No record -> Create Hiring Decision Record. Write ai_recommendation, ai_confidence (0-100), ai_reasoning (strengths AND concerns), synthesis_summary. 10. Update Interview Synthesis: feedback_synthesis text and synthesis_status COMPLETED. A failed write -> synthesis_status ERROR, count under Errors. 11. Log Feedback Synthesis Run once. 12. Report Select, Hold, Reject, Created, Updated, Already Decided, Feedback Missing, Errors, Total. Created+Updated+Already Decided+Feedback Missing+Errors = Total.
